company_info.company_description: "Together with our dealers, leading the industry and setting high standards is something we continuously do. We are committed to providing the best products using premium materials, and use the safest, most efficient equipment sourced from around the globe."

reviews.review_description: Solarhart was very helpful pre install and during the installation.The installation was very tidy and I have no complaints.

Quote visit was on time and the rep. sat down with me for over an hour going over the brand of solar panels and inverters that they use.Price was about in the middle of the 6 quotes I received, but as I had researched the products that they would be using, I was happy with the price.Installation went smoothly and was done in the time frame I had been advised. They contacted my energy provider, I just had to contact them for a FIT price.They showed me how to connect to the Goodwe inverter app. and went through what I had to do in the case of a power outage to connect my generator to the already installed plug to my house. Very happy with my installer.

All the firms were very professional and the information I received from your site gave me knowledge to choose the best products at a great price. Your site is a great tool for people to get the facts needed. Thankyou

The company provided a very reasonable quote using efficient products with the latest technology.They installed the panels and inverter etc. within 2 weeks of the quote but were not able to connect it as they advised that because of the increased size of the system I need to have my electrical system upgraded. I am awaiting this to happen and so have no solar panels operating at present.
Quality and efficient install and good to deal with. Happy with the job from end to finish. Recommend for any install
From start to end, Solahart were professional, courteous and worked in myself and my timetable

The Solahart sales rep, Eric Ferguson, showed up at our home at the appointed time. He explained the system, outlined our options and answered our many questions in a simple, honest way. We had four reps who were to come to our home, only two showed up on time. One rang and explained that he could not be there. The fourth, we didn't hear from.The site inspection was carried out by Antoine, who was knowledgable and we were able to discuss different aspects of the installation such as orientation of the panels and positioning of the Inverter. There was a hiccup with the initial installation date as the company did not have some necessary parts for the inverter. Installation was delayed by ten days but went ahead smoothly by Antoine and his team. Grid connection is done and smart meter is in the system for connection, hopefully soon.

Started our Solar journey after many hours on Finns site and his excellent explanation of all details.5-6 years ago had a 10kw system fitted with a 8.5kw inverter. With electricity suppliers dishing out reasonable rates we cut our bill dramatically and all was good. Had the Solahart hot water system too which has been superb.Recently (Nov 23) upgraded to 14kw of panels, 10kw inverter and a Solahart 9.8kw battery.Very pleased so far but expected to be pretty much off grid but due to big summer here on east coast OZ we been smashing the AC a lot!!The disappointing recent drop in feed in tariff has really pizzed us off thanks to the greedy electricity companies, but we are still more than happy with the system and the return it’s giving. Will try updating after 12 months with battery.There are only couple disappointing issues we have and are having:- The battery retains 8% of it charge to do ‘its thing’, didn’t know this, so in actually fact you only get about 9kw that is useable, to get totally off grid, we need another 5kw of storage. (Family 4 all grown up)- The battery seems to require regular  ‘software’ updates, new technology so I can accept that, but when it does a software update the bloody thing just stops working. Don’t charge or discharge. Need to call support and they do their thing, takes a couple days and back running again. Annoying.Don’t know for sure if that is correct but that’s what Solahart tell us.

The sales quoting process was very informative - easy going and met our requirements to change out our Gas hot water to solar and update our existing Solar PV.The quote was informative with the potential savings of solar PV with a battery.The installation was organised very quickly once the Government provider Energex finally approved our 10kW system on single phase. The Hot water plumbers were polite and very efficient and the supporting electrician very tidy and punctual and installed a quality product.Our Solar PV and battery were installed in a timely manner , the staff were punctual and friendly and did a quality install of 21 panels in 3 strings and then the battery installed in our garage. The GE Hybrid inverter has been doing a great job, providing an excellent backup during 2 recent power outages - very seamless did not know we were experiencing a blackout till a friend sent us a text.Highly recommend Solarhart to anybody looking for a great service and install.
Quoting process was great fully explained everything before making quote, actually visited premisses before making quote, punctual and got back to me when they said they would.

After having a 3ish month delay due to the older P-Type SolaHart Silhouette panels hitting end of life and being replaced by the newer N-Type 415Watt panels, we eventually got our 12.86 KW system installed and came online in Feb 2023.The install was very smooth, the installers were quick and efficient and had to change orientation to fit all the ordered panels on my roof, so that's an extra point for the installer crew and a deducted point for the design and configuration department.All certification paperwork, council approvals, network communications etc were handled by SolaHart and other than having to signa few forms went off without a hitch.I bought a solar only system with a string inverter and the ROI is just over 4 years saving me about $3500 a year, I had $1200 worth of account credit (I used to pay 3 months ahead) has been reduced to $900 after a full year and I haven't paid a cent to the network provider all year. My old $3800 annual cost is now only $300 and that's after the price rise this year.I'm happy with the price, product, install & quality of the system sold and look forward to a day when home system battery prices start to match the continually falling production cost

Was an ok quotation process, but they are materially more expensive than comparable quotes. We only chose them because of their long time in business. They did install quickly, and installers were very professional, good install.I was quite disappointed when the salesman tried to increase their already very expensive quote by 10% on the day before the install, because he forgot to add a Safety Fuse to the quote as part of the smart meter install (quote did include smart meter upgrade). We quickly declined the increase, and they agreed to proceed and absorb the cost of the safety fuse. However they didn’t tell the installation guy, and he refused to install  the smart meter on the day as the safety fuse approval wasnt communicated to him. I had to chase them, and they have agreed to come back to finish the job.

His price wasn't' the cheapest if that's what you are wondering. Sadly their system wasn't the one that we wanted. It's just that the one we wanted wouldn't give us a firm quote. Yes, I even called him and begged for a firm price, but he couldn't give us a firm price. Regrettable for them and us, rep sent me an email day later and said that they would give us a firm quote - by then however we called Solar-Hart and went with them. If he only called me we would have gone with them. Personal service seems to have gone out the door.Our experience was bit troubling as everyone, except for Solar-Hart rep were not listening to us and what our needs were, instead they only concentrated on 25 year warranty etc etc etc, hinted to them that we are aged couple and that we may not be around in 25 years time - no one listened to us except for the Solar-Hart rep - weird :-(Solar - Hart installers were just great, punctual, tidy, respectful etc. Installation went as it was stated to us.They organised everything for us, including sending info to Energex and our supplier. They were just awesome!After sales service is lacking though!  But our system is working fantastically so far. Here's hoping that it will be like that for our lifetime here.

Very easy to talk to salesman. He answered all my questions and was very knowledgeable. We were impressed that he took the time to come and talk to us face to face. The installers who did the rack and rails were very prompt and very pleasant and clearly knew what they were doing. We have no complaints at all.
The sales and quoting went ok. They set a date and the were punctual and crew was very polite and helpful. After job done  the area was cleaned. They organised the grid connection.

The solar quoting process was easy and straight forward.The installation went as planned. The traded people on time, clear on the plan for the day and did what they said they would.The customer service was good. Again, they did what they said they would and answered any questions I had.

Solahart provided timely response to enquiries and understanding of requirements.Professional installation team delivered as promised.Combining PV Panels with Solar Hot Water System gave competitive pricing.

Sales/quoting: Efficient, clear and professional communication. The salesperson arrived at the property on time. He listened and answered my questions politely. He offered a few options and we were able to choose one that met our needs. We were also helpfully instructed to prepare a number of spare roof tiles for inevitable breakages, which was something we wouldn't have thought of ourselves.Installation: Polite, clear and professional communication again. The team arrived within the indicated time frame. They were hard working as there were 29 panels in total.The customer service was excellent. The electrician explained the safety issues of the inverter and our meter box. They gave us login details to monitor the system through the online portal. The system is working well so far.

I got our panels through Solarhart which took a little while to have them installed because of such of demand. Had a good relationship with the sales people, but we had a little bit of a problem when we got our panels installed. A wrong placement of panels, which is now taking two months to get fixed. But overall, it seems like a very good system you do need to keep an eye on how the panels have been installed and make sure they are in the correct position.
Our installation team were a+. Quick response time and great service.

Would never recommend this company. Half installed system, not working to standard nor installed to Australian standard. Local solahart business, Solahart Mackay does not answer phone calls or emails, and when they do they can not honestly address concerns or severity of the matters at hand. They have now unlawfully processed payment for a non fully functioning or to standard system. Disappointing is an understatement. I would never ever consider using this company again even if were our only option. We’re now paying for solar, power and legal fees. An absolute nightmare.

Quoting was easy and professional.The installers were here on time and were very courteous and discuss the install plan prior to starting, provided some training on completion.We had to do nothing but pay the bill everything was done without issue.
The salesman actually came to my house to review the installation and talk with me the other companies didn’t.

I really appreciated the support provide by Solar Quotes before and pre purchase. They made it easy to understand the jargon, the process and provided confidence in the decisions I had to make.All companies referred were genuine and helpful. In the end I decided to go with Solarhart for an integrated solution of PV and replacement of my hot water unit with their powerstore and energy management system.
Great all round service,local install teams,non pressure sales,went with best quality panels. After sales service very good.

Sales quoting went well.Sam seemed to know what he was doing.price was reasonable compared to others.Installation went well.friendly efficient,tidy and punctual.can’t be sure if the installation was top quality as I am not an electrician nor a plumber.customer service was good too.took a week before I could monitor the system on the solar edge app.I am making much more than I need.hopefully will be enough when I get an ev one day.

After being messed around by another company for 8 months. I contacted solar quotes. Of the three companies that contacted me I went with Solahart. They were fantastic, they understood my previous terrible solar installation history and vowed to get my system up and running ASAP. Their quote was very competitive, the communication was fantastic, the staff were very helpful and prompt and the installation was completed within 2 weeks. I can't thank Solahart enough. My 10.4kw 3phase system is fantastic.

Our experience was hassle free from beginning to end. We delayed our installation for months until our tiled roof was re-sealed and painted, which was handled very well by Solarhart Hervey Bay. We chose to have 24 x 255W REC panels with a Sunny Boy 5000TL inverter. Our system is capped at 4.5kw for connection to the grid, but it reaches its maximum output early in the day and maintains it so long as there is no cloud cover. We have produced 10,000 kw/hr of solar electricity each year since the installation was completed. The only aspect that surprised me is that when the grid fails the inverter doesn’t power itself.

From the start to the finish the team has been helpful and keen to provide what I asked for. Once the quote was accepted the Installation of the solar panels went smoothly, Gateway and then installation of my Tesla battery completed ready for connection to the grid. Once connected it has been providing reliable power to my home and I couldn’t be happier. The after sales team has been helpful in getting all the paperwork sorted and submitted. I have had it going for nearly 3 years now and have  recommended them to interested people looking at going the same way.

We had a 4.8kW Goodwe solar system installed.Rodney was happy to answer any questions and came on time as well as answering phone calls and email regarding the quote, which was very competitive.Aiden and his team were a pleasure to have at our home. They were efficient and punctual with installation.Highly recommend Solarhart.

The solar quote was fantastic through solarhart, i had 3 referals through solar quotes2 of the company's give me quotes over the phone but would not come to me to do a personal visit, the last company didn't even call for a quote even after i rang them.I went with solarhart because they hade a great system and they came to me witch made me think they cared more.
Efficient, east to communicate and deal with installer.Installation took place ahead of schedule without inconvenience.Grid connection yet to take place but scheduled by provider shortly.

I’ve gone with solarhart as I have had the solarhart hot water system on my old house and I know the rep. He came down and explained all the pros and cons very well thro a bit pricey it’s all good quality with long warranties.Solaredge single phase inverters.Solarhart silhouette solar panels (25 year warranty) 20 units.Tesla powerwall 2 Battery.Solarhart roof mounted indirect hot water systemThey have only installed the hot water system so far but scheduled to install the rest tomorrow weather permitting (rain predictedWill keep you postedRegards

We had a number of quotes done through solar quotes, but found that Solahart offering the powerstore was not able to be provided by anyone else as we also wanted to remove out gas hotwater system. They did not try to get us to by a bigger system compared to the other quotes, and the quality of the system was great. Also they were one of the few that offered black solar panels. Installers we actually solahart staff, and they were able to resolve the problems that arose from the original design and communicated with us clearly the changes needed on the day.System was certified on week after install was complete and I am generally happy with the final result. Now we have to wait to see what the returns look like. After the first week of operating, only 12% of power (july 2022 - winter) was fed back into grid as the powerstore seems to do a nice job of balancing the power generated against the household consumption.

The sales quoting process through Solarquotes was excellent. I sought two quotes and both contacted me quickly. I  disregarded one very quickly (Smart Energy), as Solarquotes advised that an installation should take one day and Smart Energy said they do five a day. Also, their panels were not on the Solarquotes list of recommended panels (and their quote, interestingly, was the most expensive). Empire Solar Systems were very professional and also sent a revised quote when I asked about microinverters. However, I chose Solarhart because the provider attended my home and spent a good hour talking through options with me. They also talked to me about the SolarEdge Energy Hub inverter, which ticked all the boxes for me, combining the best of microinverters with instant DC to AC. Solarhart came to me through my local council which has an arrangement with Australian Energy Foundation and that was my third quote. The installation took place at a time of pouring rain - at one point it looked like it would have to be postponed, but the rain was heavy but intermittent and also the installers said my roof was surprisingly 'grippy', so they met their own safety precautions and continued. Notwithstanding that, the rain slowed everything down and they came back a second day, so all in all, the installation was about a day and a half (no extra cost). The installers were very professional at all times and they were polite, tidy and punctual. Solarhart organised the grid connection after the install. One other thing in Solarhart's favour is that it is owned by Rheem and they are working on an instant electric hot water system. I am future proofing my home, putting as many panels on as I can fit, so that over time I can convert to ducted air con (heating and cooling) run off my solar energy, then convert gas cooking to induction stove and electric oven (run off my solar energy), then convert instant gas hot water to instant electric hot water (run off  my solar energy). I want finally to get an EV, but may not be able to install a battery, as I live in a semi without a garage or driveway, and the inverter is on my front verandah, too far from the street where I park. By the time I get to that my local council hopefully will have charging stations installed throughout the council area. Another reason I chose Solarhart is that Rheem produces my current gas instant hot water, and I like the fact that Rheem will have an instant electric hot water option available by the time I convert. I do not want either hot water solar panels on the roof (I have used all available space for the solar panels) or a giant hot water tank, which are currently the only options for electric hot water.

The quoting process was extremely professional and Mike Mulder from Solahart is very knowledgeable and there isn't a questions he can't answer. He came out a year ago to do the initial assessment and we had to postpone the install initially.Fast forward to March of this year, called him on his mobile and he remembered who I was and very quickly provided us with a quote for 6.66kw and Solahart Powerstore water heating that was very competitive.Fast forward to last week, Carlo (apparently one of their top installers) came out with a colleague and installed the Solar Power within a day. Then the Jemena Inspector came out today and signed everything off in about 5 min.Great installers, we spent about 30 minutes discussing where the panels, inverter and cables would run on the day itself. Carlo then checked with a couple of engineers to make sure there weren't going to be any issues. Once they got the green light as mentioned earlier the 2 of them had it sorted by the end of the day.The hot water should be installed in about 3 weeks and don't expect there to be any issues. The warranty on the water heating system they were offering was by far the best.Would absolutely recommend them as I spoke to quite a few Solar installers (got about 5 quotes) and Mike, Carlo and their team were by far the most professional and knowledgeable.

When Rodney from Solarhart arrived at our house he had all the information we needed to ensure we got the best system installed. He answered all our questions and gave us the quote on the spot so we knew how much it would cost.The installation was smooth even though it looked like it was going to rain the installers kept an eye on the BOM radar and pushed through. The Solarhart installers were extremely neat and I was amazed how they got the cable from the panels down the two storey brick veneer inside wall. All I see is 2 cables coming out of the brick wall into the inverter. They broke a few tile but ensured they were replaced and cleaned up the site before they left.My system is a 9.9kw Silhouette panels with a Solaredge invertor. So far we haven't had much sun but it still produces enough electricty to cover our household appliances even when it is cloudy. When the sun did come out the system produced as high as 8.7kw which was fantastic.Overall experiance was easy with Solarhart they took care of everything.

The sales/quoting process was fine. No potential supplier was rude, unknowledgable or too pushy.The installation was trouble-free,professional and acccomplished in a little over one day's normal working hours.the customer service has been fine, too, and, yes they have made the grid-connection application
Responsive service, quality products and system which met our overall requirements and needs
Not the most organised bunch of people- but probably fine if ou have a strightforward install. Ours was complicated.

Great quotes and presentations by all recommended suppliers, on time, polite and very informative. Final choice came down to a package price for both hot water and solar package using latest technology and product warranties.
The process was good well up to the installation stage. Within two weeks of getting the quotation they came to install the system and they organised the grid connection. I was happy with the service

Solahart were the only ones to come to my home and sit down to do the quote. Because they did, I ended up getting a 8kW system instead of a 5kW, which suits my needs much better. The install was seemless with the team being punctual, polite, and tidy. I am currently waiting on my meter to be replaced but have my monitoring up and running. Very happy with Solahart Newcastle.

Very happy so far. Solarhart explained everything to me and gave me time to do my research and also gave me links to new information regarding government changes. Combined with using Solarquotes valuable information it was an easy decision.

My situation with serious shading to the north of my house resulted in several suppliers declining to quote. Of the ones who did, the Solahart Illawarra representative was helpful, knowledgeable and creative, coming up with a system that gave me confidence would function well.The installing team was careful and thorough and appears to have done a good job. None of my roof tiles were broken in spite of extensive roof work.Grid connection was smooth and trouble free.A second installation by another Solahart team added a Tesla Powerwall 2 battery and was equally competently done.My only minor gripe is that the excellent Solaredge Monitoring application provided to monitor the system performance is incompatible with the Tesla battery, which greatly reduces the application's usefulness.The Tesla monitoring app also provided is however a comprehensive alternative to the Solaredge one.

Solahart were straightforward and have a long business history, so able to provide long-term support. They were very professional to deal with and brought installation forward when requested.We were not prepared to go with an installer who suddenly gave a much cheaper price when we told them we were purchasing elsewhere or a couple that tried to sell us a larger system than we really needed.
Extremely happy with every aspect of the process through SolaHart!

The quoting was excellent, with a physical visit to my home, an inspection of roof area's and agreement on best way to lay panels, then all details and quote was later sent with the over head image and not just email of an image of an aerial shot of my roof, with panels overlaid and no site inspection as some companies do. a week before the install date the install supervisor (Electrician) attended my home, went over the design, suggested a slight alteration to the layout. The install team arrived on time and were very polite, efficient and cleaned up after themselves. On install day it was discovered that the quoted inverter was incorrect for the system type (string), the install was continued as far as possible, and two days later was completed with the correct, and upgraded inverter, that was no extra cost to myself. Solarhart sent the required paperwork to my energy supplier for connection and smart meter.

The sales and quoting process was quickThe installation is what I am most pleased with. I am a tradie and have high standards and expectations from other tradespeople and the installers were very professional and polite.They organized for grid connection following install.My only disappointment is that when I had issues with the app, it took over 2 weeks for them to get someone back to fix it.

The sales/quoting process was a bit of a mixed bag. We were happy with 3 out of 4 quoting companies and very happy with 2, although only one visited to give a quote. We went with Solahart, partially for this reason. We were impressed that from early on, 2 of the companies said it was unadvisable to get solar because of tree shade gave less than 50% efficiency. With some removal and replacement to a granny flat roof, it was just advisable. One company placed a picture of the panels on the heavily shaded roof and gave a quote.We also got a quote for solar hot water but when the plumbers arrived to install, they discovered our piping was too narrow and advised against it.Th solar electricity installation was fully professional except we were unable (and still are unable) to get wifi connection as promised.The black borderless panels look great and I assume it is working efficiently so, overall, a mixed bag.

Solarhart listened to what I wanted in an installation, and really delivered.  Their installers were polite, on time and took the time to explain the system to us well to ensure we were confident in the ongoing operation.  The grid connection and meter switch over was also organised by them and was seedless.

It's a sharks world when dealing with solar companies but I found solahart to honest professional and informed me of choices. All through the process communication has been great. Installed same day and power on by next week. I didn't go for a Rolls Royse system but very happy with the purchase. Highly recommend.
Very good no problem turned up on time left no mess
I went with solarhart only because they have been around a long time

The quotes and interaction with SolaHart Port Macquarie, Apex Solar, Future Energy Company and Solaxs was very positive and Apex Solar and FEC were particularly impressive. All quotes were provided in a timely manner. The differentiator was that SolaHart provided specific advice about seeking the best retail electricity plan to match our circumstances.  We went with the Origin Solar Boost Plan with a FiT of 18.0 cents per kWh.Our installation started at 7:30am and was completed by 4:00pm on the same day, with everything working as it should and the mess cleaned up.  All workers were punctual, polite and diligent. The work was tidy and we were very happy with the standard of the installation. The panels and inverter have worked flawlessly since installation.SolaHart Port Macquarie's customers service is excellent. Rod, David and Tahney have been proactive throughout and have followed up to ensure the system was working correctly and to ensure our expectations had been met.

Solahart were very professional from start to finish. Sales lady was factual and not pushy which we respect. Installation was quick and hassle free. Not the cheapest but we wanted peace of mind going with a company with a long history if the need to make warranty claims arises.

While I had originally started looking just at a system to take the load off my electricity bills, after speaking with the different sales people I decided to go all-in and have installed a Solar Hot Water system along with a large Solar system with battery. The information I got from the SolarQuotes site gave me great background information and allowed me to unravel the highly technical information that the different companies threw at me, and I purchased the system knowing that I was getting good value being able to compare price and capability across the different quotes. I found that even though I asked for someone to visit my home to do the quote, several of the companies provided a quote from photos only, but I found these quotes around the same price as others and ended up going with one of the companies that took the time to visit with me.
We were happy with all aspects. Have had previous dealings with them on a solar hot water system.

Great info and advice,terrific staff in office and in the field,great options offered,on time with start dates,staff insteps great friendly mob and site was left better then when they arrived.System has been performing unreal better then we thought thanks again all.Glen and Beth Finch

Punctual on install, however lightning interrupted the first install date during the panel install, so one of the strings was not connected for 10 days after the initial install. I had to remind them that the string needed to be connected which was a little frustrating.
We found solarhart from the beginning of this process through to the end was professional, and would recommend  them to my friends and family.

Quote from Solarhart was at our house and very informative and thorough.Installation was via a local electrical company who will also upkeep the solar system. Installation was fast and without any problems.Customer service was exceptional and they helped with organisation of grid connection. All in all, we are extremely satisfied with solarhart.

The rep was respectful, explained everything clearly and gave me what I asked for.The staff kept me up to date with when instillation would take place.The panels were installed on 9/9/20. The installers were polite, quick and efficient and left everything tidy. They put the inverter in a shady spot which involved a bit more work for them but that was no problem for them. They also explained how it worked and how the wifi worked.They have organised the grid connection which should happen in the next few weeks.

We are bushfire victims, lost everything in fires, had organised with sola hart to install solar system and was all good to go, got finance approved through them and then they told us they are declining because they are too busy and don't want to help us. We are now a family with 3 children left without power after we spent a lot of time going through process originally to get this sorted. They had absolutely no sympathy of the position they have now put us in. Do not deal with Ian. Completely unprofessional and a complete let down.
Installer was 1st class and they took care of everything. I went with solahart so i have after sales service and am not worried they will fold their business and leave me with no backup

Salesman turned up a couple of times.Installation was fine and any questions I had were answered. They cleared up afterwards.5 minutes late to arrive and they were contractors.Install was 2 days ago on Friday so I'm looking forward to the next step.

Blew off two appointments and attended site three times.  1st time they didnt have enough rails to attach pannels to the roof.  2nd time they ran out of cable. 3rd time they said it was good to go. Inspection failed the job due to non compliance and disconnected the system so my house didnt burn down. New crew had to come in and re-install the system. This all took 5 months.
Nothing but issues that are costing me money but know 1 on there end seems to care I'm fed up, ill be going to to Ombudsman soon if not resolved
Prompt installation, very neat and tidy job. They cleaned up afterwards. Sale follow up could have been better.
Quality product but disappointing service through installation and connectionFelt like they got sale and wiped their hands.
Thanks for your help. Some of the information that helped me through the Solar PV experience was obtained from your site or links from your site.
Another company came to house and I never heard back from them with a quote. Solarhart offered 60 months interest free.
1. the sales quote was very easy for us to understand.2. The installation was completed in one day. There was no rubbish for us to clean up.3. The grid was connected at the end of the day
3kw system with 5kw invertor so we have the option to add more panels.
Solahart was the only company which came to our house, everything was explained to our satisfaction. Five Star Power Mackay, I only can highly recommend them for their professional service.
They actually came out to look at roof (NOT JUST A QUOTE OVER THE PHONE) and also took old solar panels down free of charge where as another company had quoted 1000.00 to do that.

My hot water solar system floods my downstairs living area as overheats and sprays out hundreds of litres of steaming hot water until it empties itself - originally the tradesmen left me a bucket for the 'overflow' - I could of filled a swimming pool by now!!! had it installed six months ago and just got my water bill - it is double. Was told to 'run the house taps to alleviate the pressure' - no-one has come to look at the problem so I filmed it on my phone and sent them the USB of the footage - they still continue to act like they don't know me and hope I disappear. Just completing an unsafe product report to the office of fair trading - this nightmare cost me $5000 - and has cost me money instead of saving money as the product and company boasts - will never recommend them to anyone - EVER so rude and non existent customer service
System installed on time and no problems. The power being generated is more than we were estimated. They are not the cheapest but quality and service very good.

The installation itself went great. However their customer service is truly terrible. I would have to make a minimum of at least 3 phone calls for each issue I needed to raise before I got a response. They would promise to get back within a time period and never follow up. If you have deadlines or time pressure then I would no recommend using SolarHart.

The boys arrived on time and after a small hiccup, they did a great job and super clean. Big thanks to Todd who really sold me the system.... very passionate about the product! Although it wasnâ€™t the cheapest,I had had a Solahart before for over 20 years with no problem so it was obvious I would choose the same. Especially it being Australian made too!!I did promise Iâ€™d hunt him down if it didnâ€™t work right ( joking) but I donâ€™t envision any problems.

Thank you very much, the information on the website was very helpful. Quotes were great most of them. The Finance company that works with Solarhart is very easy to deal with and the deal is very competitive.

Solarquotes were only able to organise two quotations and I thought I would get a third from the local Solahart installer. The Solahart installer was the only one who came to the house and discussed our requirements in detail. May have paid just a little over the other two but it's difficult to know if you're comparing apples with apples. Happy with the system we have so far. Thanks for your help and info.
